global_transaction_principle: Any qualified customer. Any supported market. One digital workflow.
north_star: From any legitimate lead in the world to a completed paid digital service with minimal human friction.
invariants: This gate composes source evidence and must not create a second source of truth
Advisory modules must never become implicit authority to advance a hard lifecycle state
Commercial KPI progression must never authorize a hard lifecycle transition
Visitor state carries no project or payment authority
Qualified lead status must not bypass market support or global commerce readiness
Payment evidence alone must not advance a project to BUILDING
Material scope change requires approved Change Request before build continues on changed scope
UAT or customer acceptance requires customer evidence
Repeat or referral status requires completed delivery and customer acceptance evidence
Unknown stale missing or contradictory hard-gate evidence returns HOLD
Project size may reduce optional process but cannot bypass mandatory consequential gates
Production deployment authority remains separate and HUMAN_ONLY
